quote.text:
$ETH Pretty interesting to see how this has moved so far relative to the 2025 move.

- Bottom of this trend started around $1.5K
- Took off with a quick +30% move after retaking $1750
- Rejected $2.8K high timeframe level
- Retested $2.1K high timeframe level

Let's see how we do from here. I've been mentioning these $2.1K and $2.8K levels for the past few years as they have been so influential on Ethereum's price action.

As long as these levels are being respected as strong support & resistances, I would recommend having them on your charts.

I consider this a strong support until it actually breaks lower. For now it can be a good area for a potential higher low to be created.

Most of the 2017 class went broke or quit, brother.

The full zero-knowledge proof for the proof-of-reserves snapshot completed by Binance at 08:00 on October 31, 2026 (UTC+8)covering BTC, ETH, USDT, BNB, SOL, USDC, XRP, USD1, RLUSD, and ZEC has been generated. Binance users holding any one of these ten tokens can now independently verify whether their Binance account balance is backed by reserves of at least 1:1. 
We will generate more reserve snapshots on November 04, 2026. Computation is required from the snapshot to the updated full zero-knowledge proof, and the generation time depends on the number of tokens. It is currently estimated that generating the zero-knowledge proof will take about 40 to 50 hours after the snapshot is completed.💁🏻‍♀️

Well, after more than a month, the picture is finally getting clearer.

My read on Bitcoin was pretty accurate, and price action is continuing to develop exactly along the lines I anticipated.

My outlook remains unchanged.

I expect BTC to revisit the range lows around $60K in the coming weeks or months, with $40K as my next major downside target after that.

Nothing has changed in my thesis. The market is simply taking its time to play out.

Patience. The bigger move may still be ahead of us.

They’re playing with you in both directions.

In a few months, all of this will look much clearer.

$BTC
